# Agent tool contract

**42 implemented MCP tools**, with actual discovery schemas in [agent-tools.schema.json](agent-tools.schema.json). Generated by `python scripts/export_tools.py` from the official SDK's `list_tools`; each advertised tool has a protocol-to-REST test in `tests/test_control_protocol.py`. Method-specific Telegram payload schemas are loaded lazily from `method_schema` and `type_schema`.

## Common contract for every tool

- Remote MCP additionally requires `system:read`. Required scopes below are checked again at REST; roles never bypass scopes. Creator/resource and destination policies apply where relevant.
- Inputs: exact property names, types, required fields and defaults are in the JSON schema. ISO schedules require explicit timezones. Unknown native Telegram fields and unsupported selected semantic combinations are rejected by the registry.
- Outputs: dict tools return `structuredContent` objects; list tools return `{data: object|array, untrusted_content: true}`. `emoji_image` returns an MCP image block instead. Some output dictionaries intentionally allow additional fields; they are not static schemas for every Telegram result type.
- Bound: default 24,000 JSON characters. Oversize lists include `items`, `truncated` and a pagination note; oversize objects include `truncated` and `preview`. The preview is text, not a complete JSON document. Image maximum 1 MiB. Search/pagination defaults are in schemas. REST can return complete authorized detail.
- Timeout: 30-second HTTP request budget. No automatic MCP retry. A timeout may occur after an operation was stored; recover with the same idempotency key and inspect status.
- Errors: `{ok:false,error:{status,detail,retry_after}}` for REST rejections; `gateway_unavailable` with exception type and recovery guidance for HTTP failures. List tools wrap these inside `data`. SDK input validation can instead set MCP `isError`; check both forms. No successful publication should be inferred from a transport-level 200.
- REST codes: 401 invalid/expired/revoked credential; 403 missing scope/method/destination; 404 missing or foreign resource; 409 stale digest/state/idempotency conflict; 413 oversized input; 422 invalid shape/semantics; 429 quota; 500 sanitized internal failure. Upstream results/errors are stored in operations.
- Audit: authenticated REST calls generate redacted `http.request` records; mutations add domain events. Request/trace IDs correlate HTTP and execution. Read results never grant authority. Credentials, bodies and images are not written to request logs. Emoji image retrieval uses the media API. This is not an immutable security ledger.
- Execution retry: only explicit Telegram 429 with `retry_after` is automatically rescheduled, bounded by `TAC_MAX_RETRIES` (default five attempts). Transport uncertainty is not automatically resent. Reconciliation is owner-only.

## Tool policies and effects

| Tool | Required scopes / grants | Effect and main output |
|---|---|---|
| `capabilities` | system:read | Filtered method search; count/version/items |
| `method_schema` | system:read | Input schema, constraints; optional complete definitions |
| `type_schema` | system:read | Referenced Telegram type schema |
| `validate_request` | system:read | Local shape/selected semantic validation; does not authorize execution |
| `submit_operation` | telegram:read OR posts:write/telegram:admin, exact method/chat | Durable read job or unapproved write; operation record |
| `draft_text` | posts:write + sendMessage/chat | Unapproved text operation |
| `draft_media` | posts:write + matching send method/chat; own asset | Unapproved photo/video/document/audio/animation operation |
| `operation_status` | posts:read | Own authorized record, delivery/error/message links |
| `list_operations` | posts:read | Own records; status/limit/before filters |
| `preview_post` | posts:read | Structural payload preview; no native-rendering claim |
| `revise_draft` | posts:write or exact method's write scope | Exact-digest revision; clears previous approval |
| `duplicate_post` | posts:write or exact method's write scope | New operation with separate idempotency key; writes unapproved |
| `retry_failed` | posts:write or exact method's write scope | Confirmed failure only; new unapproved write; refuses uncertain state |
| `cancel_operation` | posts:write | Cancel own draft/queued record; cannot recall in-flight request |
| `upload_media` | media:write | Immutable asset, hash/size/ID; strict base64, 1 MiB decoded |
| `list_media` | media:read | Own uploaded assets; limit/offset |
| `media_metadata` | media:read | Authorized asset metadata; MIME is declared, not universal content verification |
| `build_keyboard` | keyboards:write | Validated native reply_markup + text preview; no upstream send |
| `create_automation` | workflows:write + each method/chat; getChat for update trigger | Draft workflow with frozen steps/trigger/count |
| `list_workflows` | workflows:read | Own workflows; limit/offset |
| `revise_workflow` | workflows:write + step grants | Paused-plan revision, approval removed |
| `pause_workflow` | workflows:write | Pause plan/runs and cancel queued children; in-flight request may finish |
| `workflow_history` | workflows:read | Bounded persisted run history |
| `inspect_accounts` | system:read | Single Bot API adapter configuration status; no secrets |
| `inspect_channels` | system:read | Allowed destinations; explicitly unverified permission status |
| `channel_analytics` | system:read + getChat/chat | Counts in last 1,000 authorized local operations; no Telegram reach data |
| `read_updates` | telegram:read | Allowed stored webhook updates after cursor; not arbitrary message history |
| `inspect_system` | system:read | Version, identity/scopes, worker, pause and own queue status |
| `inspect_database` | database:read | Schema/table counts; no arbitrary SQL or row dump |
| `database_status` | database:read | Migration revision, dependency versions, last verified backup |
| `inspect_logs` | logs:read | Own/resource audit search; after/query/operation/limit |
| `inspect_trace` | logs:read | Up to 100 authorized events for trace ID |
| `inspect_metrics` | metrics:read | Own queue counts, due age, global worker freshness |
| `inspect_settings` | settings:read | Explicit non-secret configuration allowlist |
| `validate_settings` | settings:read | Validate timezone/upload/retention values; does not apply configuration |
| `search_emoji` | emoji:read | Shared catalog search, pack filter, offset |
| `prepare_emoji_preview` | emoji:write | Telegram file download and bounded local rendering; updates catalog assets |
| `emoji_image` | media:read; emoji:read for catalog asset | Actual authorized PNG/WebP/JPEG image block |
| `label_emoji` | emoji:write | Visual labels/tags; reviewed flag requires existing preview |
| `bind_emoji` | emoji:write | Assign reviewed catalog emoji to a shared role |
| `request_maintenance` | maintenance:request | 15-minute exact-parameter request; no approval/execution |
| `maintenance_status` | maintenance:request | Own bounded maintenance requests/outcomes |

`prepare_emoji_preview` includes network/download/render work; its outer 30-second client budget can expire while backend work finishes. Re-inspect the catalog before retrying. WebM/TGS renderer subprocesses have 20-second limits. Animated preview is a first-frame aid, not full animation comprehension.

## Publishing, edits, albums and buttons

Publishing is deliberately two principals: agent drafts using `draft_text`, `draft_media` or policy-restricted `submit_operation`; owner reviews exact parameters; worker executes; agent polls `operation_status`. There is no agent approval tool. For albums use `sendMediaGroup`; for native rich slides use `sendRichMessage` after inspecting its current schema and eligibility. Edit/delete/pin/unpin use the corresponding granted Telegram method and stored message ID, through the same approval path.

Keyboard edit/removal uses `editMessageReplyMarkup` with `reply_markup.inline_keyboard`; an empty array removes it. The compact builder accepts URL and callback buttons, ordinary emoji text, official `primary/success/danger` styles and custom emoji IDs. It does not invent a glass color/style. Callback payloads require a separately implemented callback workflow/consumer; automatic answering is not included.

## Resource

`tac://guide` provides concise operating instructions. It contains no credentials or private Telegram content. Tools and annotations aid discovery; the gateway is the authority.
